title: {{NAME}} and the Fairy Superhero Squad
moral: Even the smallest person can be a very big hero.

pages.content:
{{NAME}} flew his toy cape through the park.
Oak trees and rose bushes lined the path.
A white cat and a brown rabbit watched him.
Then a tiny glow zoomed past his ear.
Then another. Then ten more!

pages.content:
The glowing lights stopped in front of {{NAME}}.
They were tiny fairies! All in little capes.
Each one had a different bright colour.
{{NAME}}'s eyes went huge and round.
"We need a hero," said the red fairy.

pages.content:
A mean wind had trapped animals in the big pond.
A duck and two frogs were stuck on a tiny island.
The fairies could not lift them. Too heavy!
{{NAME}} waded right into the cool water.
He lifted the duck up high above the waves.

pages.content:
The animals shook and ruffled happily.
The fairies pinned a tiny star badge on his chest.
"You are an official hero," said the red fairy.
The duck and frogs sat close to {{NAME}}.
He felt very proud and very, very sleepy.
Goodnight, {{NAME}}. Tomorrow the fairies have a new mission, and only you can lead it.
